newsitem.title: USA: Boston Authority head seeks new convention center.
newsitem.headline: Boston Authority head seeks new convention center.

text.p: The new head of Boston's Redevelopment Authority said in an interview with the Boston Globe that his top priority is a new convention center.

"First and foremost - the mayor has talked about it numerous times - the city of Boston, the BRA, we really want to get a convention center approved by the state Legislature, and we want to get ground broken on that this year," the head of the authority, Thomas O'Brien, told the newspaper.

Asked how he would pay for a convention center, O'Brien replied, "The mayor (Thomas Menino) put forward a plan some months ago, which involved some taxes on Boston institutions, Boston hotels, Boston restaurants.

"We have worked hard to try and generate the political consensus for the revenues that might be required by the House," he said, adding the center "is a great economic development project. It is a project that creates jobs, it is a project that creates economic opportunity for a variety of people in Massachusetts."
